mistake.headline:
Legs stay still.
Only the ball moves.
mistake.body: If you just stay there and move the ball, you're not really working as much. Moving your legs is what makes this work.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan in a V-sit with his knees swung to one side and the ball on the other

fix.headline:
Swing your legs
side to side.
fix.body: Balance on your butt, knees up. Move your legs to one side and bounce the ball there, then switch. The ball is [em]just a counterweight.[/em]

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan balanced in a V-sit with his feet off the ground

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for the V-sit twist
items: Balance on your butt, knees in the air.
Legs go side to side on every rep.
Do them after toe touches so your obliques take over.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy who does V-sit twists like he's passing the salt.

cta.follow: One fix a week, filmed on me.
